Package neqsim.process.safety.depressurization

Class SteadyFlareGasNetwork

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.depressurization.SteadyFlareGasNetwork
public final class SteadyFlareGasNetwork extends Object
Simultaneous fixed-opening gas discharge through individual inlet lines, devices and tailpipes into one header and one rated flare tip. Pipes use the horizontal isothermal Darcy pressure-squared relation at constant gas properties and specified Darcy factor. The tip uses a quadratic or tabulated pressure characteristic up to its rated flow. The solution compares available capacity with demand; it does not prescribe the demand as the discharge.
Version:
1.0
Author:

  • Method Details

    • setKnockoutPressureDrop

      public SteadyFlareGasNetwork setKnockoutPressureDrop(String drumTag, double[] flowKgS, double[] dropBar)
      Install a knockout drum between the common pipe outlet and the tip. The supplied steady dry-gas curve includes the port-to-port loss at the modeled gas conditions. Interpolation is linear between adjacent rating points.
      Parameters:
      drumTag - unique knockout drum tag
      flowKgS - increasing gas mass flow coordinates starting at zero, kg/s
      dropBar - nondecreasing port-to-port pressure differences starting at zero, bar
      Returns:
      this network

      Connect a PSV at fixed lift or a fixed-opening BDV to the common header.
      Parameters:
      deviceTag - unique device tag identifying the branch
      sourceBara - absolute stagnation pressure in the source, bara
      inlet - pipe from source to device inlet
      areaM2 - open nozzle flow area, m2 (zero for a closed device)
      cd - discharge coefficient
      tailpipe - pipe from discharge flange to the header junction
      maxOutletBara - optional device-specific absolute outlet pressure limit, bara, or null if unavailable
      Returns:
      this network
